create_Step3ToolParser: create a Step3ToolParser instance with a tokenizer and optional tools list to parse model tool call outputs
extract_tool_calls: extract tool calls from a model output string using Step3ToolParser with XML-like delimiters
extract_tool_calls_streaming: extract tool calls incrementally from a streaming text delta using stateful cursor-based parsing
adjust_request: adjust a ChatCompletionRequest or ResponsesRequest to skip special tokens when tool calls are enabled
parse_steptml_invoke: parse steptml XML tags from action text to extract function name and parameter key-value pairs
